title: Distributed Semantic Segmentation With Improved Rate-Distortion Trade-Off
abstract: arXiv:2608.28684v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Distributed deep neural networks (DNNs) for dense perception tasks such as semantic segmentation execute an encoder DNN on edge devices, and a decoder DNN typically on a large-scale cloud platform with a particular constraint on transmission bitrate. Recent works employ source codecs to enable bitrate-efficient transmission between the edge device and the cloud. However, as these approaches are typically bound to a particular type of source codec and alternative network architectures are often not explored, this results in a suboptimal rate-distortion (RD) trade-off in the low-bitrate regime. In this work, we propose two novel source codecs that \textit{enable extremely low bitrates, while improving RD performance}. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed source codecs by achieving state-of-the-art performance in distributed semantic segmentation at below 0.2 (0.03) bits per pixel, measured using the mean intersection-over-uni

translated_title: 具有改进率失真权衡的分布式语义分割
translated_abstract: 用于语义分割等密集感知任务的分布式深度神经网络（DNN）在边缘设备上执行编码器DNN，而解码器DNN通常在具有特定传输比特率限制的大规模云平台上执行。近期的工作采用信源编解码器来实现边缘设备与云端之间高效的比特率传输。然而，由于这些方法通常受限于特定类型的信源编解码器，且往往未探索其他网络架构，导致在低比特率情况下的率失真（RD）权衡并不理想。在这项工作中，我们提出了两种新型信源编解码器，能够在实现极低比特率的同时提升RD性能。我们通过在低于0.2（0.03）比特每像素的条件下，以平均交并比（mean IoU）衡量的分布式语义分割任务中取得最先进的性能，证明了所提出信源编解码器的有效性。
tldr: 本文提出两种新型信源编解码器，能够在极低比特率（低于0.2/0.03比特每像素）下改进率失真性能，并在分布式语义分割任务中实现最先进的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes two novel source codecs that enable extremely low bitrates while improving rate-distortion performance, achieving state-of-the-art results in distributed semantic segmentation at below 0.2 (0.03) bits per pixel.
